title: Derekh Hokhmah (Hebrew, Amsterdam imprint)
author: Moshe Chaim Luzzatto
description: Derekh Hokhmah (The Way of Wisdom) by Rabbi Moshe Chaim Luzzatto (the Ramchal, 1707-1746), the Italian Kabbalist, ethicist and poet, here in a Hebrew printed edition from Amsterdam, where Luzzatto lived in the late 1730s. A short work in dialogue form between a sage and a student, it sets out the proper order and method for studying the Torah and its branches: Scripture, Mishnah and Talmud, law, ethics and finally the hidden wisdom of Kabbalah, explaining the purpose of each discipline and how knowledge leads to love and service of God. It reflects Luzzatto's systematic approach, also seen in Derekh Hashem and Mesillat Yesharim, of presenting Jewish theology and mysticism in an ordered, rational framework. It is valued as a guide to the curriculum and goals of Torah learning.
